core.title: 5 x 5 Inch Ball Bearing Hinge, PBB BB815050

text.description_html:
PBB BB815050, 5 x 5 Inch Ball Bearing Hinge

Standard duty .146" thickness ball bearing hinge. Standard full mortise hinge with 5 knuckle design with two ball bearings. Polished Brass finish. For standard weight / average frequency use doors with square door edge.

Specifications: for PBB BB815050 Ball Bearing Hinge

  • Hinge Height: 5"
  • Hinge Width: 5"
  • Corners: Square
  • Two (2) Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • Thickness: 0.146" (Standard Duty)
  • Hinge Material: Steel
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • BHMA Certified Hinge
  • Non-Handed
  • For Square Door Edge
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Full Mortise - Conforms to ANSI A8122
  • Finish: Polished Brass
